description: This file contains unit tests for the CallLogHandler class, verifying its behavior for various input scenarios including permission checks, JSON validity, filtering, pagination, and error handling in an Android environment.

classes.name: CallLogHandlerTest
classes.description: Test class for CallLogHandler, containing multiple test cases to validate call log search functionality.

classes.name: FakeCallLogDataSource
classes.description: Mock implementation of CallLogDataSource used for testing, simulating permission checks, search results, and failures.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_requiresPermission
methods.description: Tests if the handler correctly denies access when permission is not granted.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_rejectsInvalidJson
methods.description: Ensures the handler responds with an error when given invalid JSON input.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_returnsCallLogs
methods.description: Verifies that the handler correctly returns a list of call logs based on a simple request.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withFilters
methods.description: Checks if filtering parameters correctly filter the call logs returned.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withPagination
methods.description: Tests if pagination parameters limit and offset work properly.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withDefaultParams
methods.description: Tests default parameter behavior when no JSON input is provided.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withNullFields
methods.description: Verifies serialization when call log fields are null.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_clampsLimitAndOffsetBeforeSearch
methods.description: Ensures the limit and offset are clamped to acceptable ranges before executing a search.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_mapsSearchFailuresToUnavailable
methods.description: Checks that provider failures are mapped to a specific error code indicating unavailability.
